import json
import signal
import sys
from urllib.parse import unquote
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait, Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

settings = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
driver = None

def deadline(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError('Search browser proof exceeded 25 seconds')

signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, deadline)
signal.alarm(25)
try:
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
    options.binary_location = '/usr/bin/chromium'
    for option in ['--headless=new', '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--window-size=1280,960']:
        options.add_argument(option)
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=options)
    driver.set_page_load_timeout(8)
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 6)
    driver.get(settings['url'])
    name, value = settings['cookie'].split('=', 1)
    driver.add_cookie({'name': name, 'value': value, 'path': '/'})
    driver.get(settings['url'] + '/?browser-fixture=authenticated#/search?orgId=' + settings['orgId'])
    query = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-query"]')))
    query.send_keys('label:Sh')
    wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[role="listbox"] [role="option"]')) == 1)
    query.send_keys(Keys.ARROW_DOWN)
    query.send_keys(Keys.ENTER)
    wait.until(lambda browser: query.get_attribute('value') == 'label:"Ship today"')
    query.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    query.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    query.send_keys('project:FIND AND (priority>=3 OR status:__absent__)')
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-submit"]'))).click()
    result_selector = '[data-testid="search-result-' + settings['issueId'] + '"]'
    wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, result_selector)))
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//summary[normalize-space()="Build a compound query with fields and groups"]').click()
    root = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-builder .query-group')
    root.find_element(By.XPATH, './/button[normalize-space()="Add condition"]').click()
    condition = root.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-condition')
    Select(condition.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[0]).select_by_value('priority')
    wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-condition option[value=">="]')))
    condition = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-condition')
    Select(condition.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')[1]).select_by_value('>=')
    condition.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'input').send_keys('3')
    wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.query-builder code').text == '(priority>=3)')
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Apply and search"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: query.get_attribute('value') == '(priority>=3)')
    wait.until(lambda browser: '(priority>=3)' in browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'section[aria-label="Search results"] code').text)
    query.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    query.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    query.send_keys('"<script>"')
    wait.until(lambda browser: '"<script>"' in unquote(browser.find_element(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Link to this query').get_attribute('href')))
    wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-submit"]'))).click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, result_selector + ' mark')) > 0)
    assert len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results script')) == 0
    assert not driver.execute_script('return Boolean(window.__searchInjected)')
    query.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL)
    query.send_keys(Keys.BACKSPACE)
    query.send_keys('Keyboard')
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Save search"]').click()
    name_input = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input')))
    name_input.send_keys('Browser saved query')
    driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//form[contains(@class,"filter-form")]//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').click()
    wait.until(lambda browser: 'Saved “Browser saved query”.' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
    pause = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Pause updates"]')
    pause.click()
    wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Resume updates"]')))
    print(json.dumps({'keyboardCompletion': True, 'compoundResults': True, 'escapedHighlight': True, 'savedFilter': True, 'livePause': True, 'typedBuilder': True}))
except Exception:
    if driver:
        print(json.dumps({'browserUrl': driver.current_url, 'body': driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text[:12000], 'logs': driver.get_log('browser'), 'searchRequests': driver.execute_script("return performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(item=>item.name.includes('/search?')).map(item=>item.name)"), 'queryValue': driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="search-query"]').get_attribute('value'), 'resultHtml': driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results').get_attribute('innerHTML') if driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results') else ''}), file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver:
        driver.quit()
